winterRevision: Two approved-sheet repeated cocoa mugs and eleven later repeated drinks replaced by distinct scenes. Thirty-two existing winter paintings moved out of the ordinary collection, with new ordinary paintings in their place. Unused atlas tiles are excluded from the level database.

validation.note: Pixel hashes are a screening aid; semantic similarity was also reviewed manually. No device FPS or live platform advertising claims.

colorTreatment: Left-hand palette squares filter the painting; unrelated visible buckets become 28% opaque, including labels and mechanic icons. Mystery and locked colors stay undisclosed. The multicolor square restores every color. Interactive two-step tutorial on campaign level 2.

customization.preview: Shared native background, conveyor and casing renderers; preview selection does not apply or unlock a theme.
customization.iapStatus: Purchase/restoration callbacks and 16 product tags prepared; platform catalog registration and live prices remain external.
customization.selection: Each category has its own saved selection; legacy whole-theme selection is retained as the fallback for existing profiles.
customization.ownership: Original styles 0–11 retain shared ownership. Detailed backgrounds 12–23 have independent IAP ownership and separate sand_background_* products; unlocking a conveyor/casing style does not unlock its paid background.
customization.animation: Conveyor motifs follow actual BeltTravel, wrap within the deck, and animate in the large preview while the game is paused. Casings and background stay stationary.
customization.backgroundApplication: Selected background is a child of MosaicBackdrop, rendered above the base gradient; live screenshot pixel differences are checked.
customization.detailedCasings: Inset panels, fasteners, vent slots, slats and circuit/pipe ornament; preview uses the live mesh.
customization.sceneryDetail: Complete naturalistic painterly background illustrations matched to the approved sand-art reference, with quiet central areas for gameplay overlays. Procedural scenic clipart replaced.
customization.inventorySupport: Connected rack, five physical shelf planes, contact shadows, feet, and uprights supporting the conveyor. Existing loop inventory conveyor renders above the rack backing; bucket layout and hit areas remain intact.
